classification: Original generic training equipment. Physical construction is representative, not manufacturer CAD, a certified product design or a service instruction. The immutable rear bench terminals remain a teaching interface where the real equipment uses flying leads or front-facing installation clamps.
coordinateContract: Recipe Y-up geometry, +Z operating front, -Z canonical rear connections. Blender root rotation converts coordinates for modelling/export. All terminal IDs and parent transforms remain unchanged across inspection views.

sources.title: ABB miniature circuit breaker cutaway
sources.architecture: Fixed/moving contacts, bimetal, magnetic solenoid, trip lever, separated arc plates and DIN clip.

sources.title: Phoenix Contact screw connection technology
sources.architecture: Current cage, captive pressure plate and threaded actuator protect conductors from screw rotation. Exact tension sleeve design varies by product.

sources.title: Schneider TeSys Deca contactor data
sources.architecture: Three main normally-open poles, AC coil and distinct auxiliary contacts. Teaching geometry uses double-break contacts and a laminated magnetic core.

sources.title: ABB low-voltage motor construction catalogue
sources.architecture: Stator frame, rotor/shaft, bearings, end shields, terminal board, fan and fan cover. Generic motor architecture only: the models have no explosion-protection claim.

sources.title: MK Logic Plus catalogue
sources.architecture: Domestic socket safety shutters, switch mechanisms and separated wiring chambers. Teaching accessory body is original.

sources.title: Resideo motorised zone valve construction
sources.architecture: Motorised powerhead, spring return, manual lever and auxiliary end switch. Bench terminal layout is not the manufacturer's flying-lead termination.

sources.title: Triton T80 Easi-Fit Plus parts architecture
sources.architecture: Heater can, pressure/flow module, solenoid, thermal cut-out and outlet. Generic physical architecture only.

sources.title: Myenergi zappi installation and operating manual
sources.architecture: Main power switching, core-balance sensing, control board, grid measurement input, enclosure seals and pilot interface. No model-specific protection certification is simulated.

sources.title: Siemens S7-1200 system manual
sources.architecture: DIN mounting, keyed removable terminal connectors, CPU and separately identified I/O. CPU logic and safety processing remain abstract.

sources.title: Grundfos pump construction instructions
sources.architecture: Volute, impeller, shaft seal, O-ring and shaft fixing. Hydraulic behaviour is an educational operating block.

sources.title: Aico Ei146e optical alarm
sources.architecture: Optical smoke chamber, backup cell and mains base; labyrinth, piezo sounder and circuit board are representative.

sources.title: Fluke tester fuse and shunt explanation
sources.architecture: Current measurement uses a low-value shunt and correct input fuse. Input protection geometry is illustrative and carries no instrument CAT rating.

sources.title: Dimplex XLE storage heater instructions
sources.architecture: Refractory energy cells around sheathed elements, insulation, thermal controls and restrained wiring.

sources.title: ABB Review low-voltage variable-speed drive architecture
sources.architecture: Supply rectifier, capacitive DC link, semiconductor inverter and control electronics. Semiconductor switching, firmware and waveforms are simplified.

sources.title: LAPP cable gland construction and functions
sources.architecture: Threaded body, compression nut, sealing insert, locknut and independent strain relief.

sources.title: Schneider distribution fundamentals: system protection
sources.architecture: MOV suppression and status indication. Transient physics and product coordination are not reproduced by the steady-state solver.
